statement: Labour share (nonfarm business, 4-quarter average) in 2027 is >= 1 pp below 2025 (Bloc A BLS Productivity & Costs; Q4 2027 release)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable at the timeline start (2025 baseline did not exist). The only in-window release (Q3 2022 revised, 2022-12-07) showed productivity down 1.3% y/y with unit labour costs up 5.3% y/y and real hourly compensation down a record 4.0% y/y; no labour-share level is stated in the release text, so none is recorded.

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office, Q3 2022 revised: nonfarm business productivity +0.8% (annualised) in the quarter but -1.3% y/y; unit labour costs +5.3% over four quarters; real hourly compensation -4.0% y/y, the largest four-quarter decline since the series began in 1948.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS, Productivity and Costs, Third Quarter 2022, Revised (USDL 22-2265), 2022-12-07 (verified via web_extract this run). Rising unit labour costs alongside falling real compensation reflect high inflation; release gives no labour-share level. Baseline context only for a 2027-vs-2025 test.
items.value: -1.3% productivity y/y Q3 2022; ULC +5.3% y/y; real hourly comp -4.0% y/y

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office's daily note restating the Q3 2022 revision: productivity fell 1.3% y/y after y/y declines of 0.4% in Q1 and 2.1% in Q2 2022, i.e. three consecutive quarters of falling output per hour.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS, The Economics Daily, 'Nonfarm business productivity down 1.3 percent from third quarter 2021 to third quarter 2022', 2022-12-12 (verified via web_extract this run).
